about: Niagara-on-the-Lake is a town at the mouth of the Niagara River on Lake Ontario, in Niagara Region, Ontario. Colonial streetscapes, wineries, and the Shaw Festival make it one of Canada’s best-known heritage and tourism towns, distinct from the Falls corridor to the south. About 19,000 people live in Niagara-on-the-Lake.
seoSummary: Niagara heritage town at the Niagara River mouth—Shaw Festival, wineries, and colonial Old Town, not Niagara Falls.
